title: N11 fold is fictitious: gallery.retries is a dead field, GALLERY_MAX_RETRIES does not exist, and the stage machine still retries unbounded
evidence:
app/gallery.odin:57:
	retries:  int, // N11: the condition-poll frame budget (GALLERY_MAX_RETRIES)

gallery_frame polls never touch it (same for .Select_Release/.Noc/.Deselect/.Settings):
	case .Draw_Release:
		if !pipe_live(app) {
			gallery.wait = 5 // the commit lands via the executor — poll
			return false
		}

repo-wide grep 'retries' (excluding audio): only app/gallery.odin:57 — the field is never read or written; grep 'GALLERY_MAX_RETRIES': only the comment on line 57.
detail: b4154c3 claims N1-N15 folded, but the N11 mechanism is absent: no constant, no counter, no abort. The unbounded condition-poll hang r1 flagged remains byte-for-byte.
recommended_fix: Implement the budget: define GALLERY_MAX_RETRIES, increment gallery.retries on every condition-poll re-arm, and abort with the stage name when it exceeds.

title: Delta-introduced: the audio seam refactor deleted rl.CloseAudioDevice with no seam wrapper — normal builds never close the audio device
detail: The refactor wrapped 17 call sites but deleted the 18th teardown call instead of wrapping it. Non-SW builds now leak the miniaudio device/context at exit — a behavior change the seam was forbidden to make.
recommended_fix: Add audio_close_device to the seam (no-op under PP_SW_AUDIO; rl.CloseAudioDevice otherwise) and call it at audio_destroy's end, restoring the pre-refactor teardown idiom.

title: N10 unfixed and now worse: the seam's comment points at gallery-build documentation that does not exist — the PP_SW_AUDIO app build remains irreproducible
detail: Nothing in-repo sets or documents PP_SW_AUDIO; gallery.odin documents neither the define nor the app SW build command, so the fix commit added a dangling reference while claiming N10 folded.
recommended_fix: Add the SW app build line (ODIN_ROOT=… odin build app -define:PP_DEBUG=true -define:PP_SW_AUDIO=true) to build_raylib_sw.sh or gallery.odin's header, and point the seam comment at it.

title: N2 half-folded: font_check still cites the deleted load_hud_font and the removed rune→byte truncation; lint.sh's gate-6 rationale and two noc_overlay comments are also stale
detail: crisis.odin/goldens.odin comments were fixed, but the exact font_check pair r1 cited remains (draw_text_c is UTF-8-safe since this PR; load_hud_font is deleted), lint names a nonexistent mechanism, noc comments lag the ladder/mono changes.
recommended_fix: Update the five sites: draw_text_c copies raw UTF-8 now; the loader is load_fonts; lint gate 6 is the ASCII-content canon (drop the truncation mechanism); noc_row 15 body/12-13 labels; noc_col says font_mono.

title: N1 residual: the specimen's SLA row stays 14px while the shipped SLA gauge line is 17px
evidence:
harness/font_check.odin:119:
	draw_row(warn_font, "delivered 12 / 20   avg 0.9 s   loss 0%", y, 14, p.ink_soft) // the 14px SLA line
app/main.odin:1817 (draw_sla_gauges):
		draw_text(app, gauge, 12, sla_row_y(&app.view, line), rnd.hud(&app.view, 17), col)
detail: The ladder re-derivation fixed title/toast/crisis/hint rows but left the SLA specimen row three steps behind the shipped 17px gauge — future font evaluations would grade a stale size.
recommended_fix: Bump the specimen SLA row to 17 (and align the tabular block with the 15px NOC rows), or derive the specimen literals from the app's constants.

title: N9 unfixed: gallery remains a package-level mutable global and the debug-global carve-out is still undocumented
evidence:
app/gallery.odin:64 (file-scope, PP_DEBUG-gated):
gallery: Gallery
project-context.md:41:
- **No globals / singletons.** Everything hangs off `App` → `Run_State`, passed by pointer (ODN-13). Per-run reset = create a fresh run context in a fresh arena; never "clean up and reuse."
detail: Neither of r1's suggested resolutions happened (no App field, no project-context.md carve-out note) although b4154c3 claims N1-N15 folded.
recommended_fix: Document the PP_DEBUG-only debug-global carve-out in project-context.md, or hang Gallery on App behind a PP_DEBUG-gated field.

title: N13 unfixed: the 24px SemiBold title still carries the 22px-era clearance comment and no min-clamp clearance check exists
detail: r1 asked for a min-clamp (1280x720) spot-check or an extended title-clearance check with the wider SemiBold title; nothing was added and the stale comment stands.
